entities.summary: "Poison Heart" is a song by the punk rock band Ramones. Written by their former bassist Dee Dee Ramone and given in exchange for bail money, it was included on the 1992 album Mondo Bizarro and also released as a single. It has a slower tempo than most Ramones songs.
